changelog:
Mutual Fund Evaluator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Mutual Fund Evaluator tool for Indian retail investors
- Provides AI-powered mutual fund analysis based on investor profiling and real-time web search
- Offers personalized suitability scores, fund insights, tax implications, and actionable investment recommendations
- Supports detailed evaluation via a single /evaluate POST endpoint, with support endpoints for health check and welcome
- Comprehensive documentation with sample requests, responses, and pricing plans included
summary: AI-powered mutual fund evaluation tool for Indian retail investors using web search and investor profiling.
